en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The aim of the course is for TBD students to become familiar with various important and currently developing areas of phytopathological research, to refresh their knowledge of classical methods, and above all to gain hands-on experience with modern phytopathological and mycological research techniques.
